name: Valentinos
source:
A clergyman and inquisitor from the world's largest religious anti-heresy faction, the Holy Inquisition.
Valentinos may be reasonable in his words and deeds, but he will show no mercy to the heretics.

He visits Pandemonium in search of a lost relic, [spoiler]the Gospel of Judas[/spoiler].

[Edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url] and in-game content]

A clergyman and inquisitor from the world's largest religious anti-heresy faction, the Holy Inquisition.
Valentinos may be reasonable in his words and deeds, but he will show no mercy to the heretics.

He visits Pandemonium in search of a lost relic, [spoiler]the Gospel of Judas[/spoiler].
